title: 第372章 忽然冒出来的前赵后人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“不……不会的。”大祭司吃力的说出这句话。

刘盈挥挥手说道：“你现在或许是真的认为不会有那一天出现，也或许是觉得来的太子只不过是一个娃娃将军而已，他懂什么？时间是最强大的敌人，坚硬的石头会伴随着时间的流逝，而裂开，变成沙子，被人踩在脚底下。”

“强大的汉帝国，或许也会这样。”

刘盈完全不给大祭司狡辩的机会，他语气快速的说道：“至少，之前那个强大的秦国，不就是这样灭亡的吗？”

“你或许想说，秦国和我大汉现在的情况并不一样，但是实际上来说，匈奴的问题如果不解决的话，那就会持续很多年。”

“所以，如果你还存了侥幸心理的话，那趁早自我净化，否则的话，等到我来给你净化自我思想的时候，问题可能比你想的还要严重得多。”

大祭司离开席位，向着刘盈跪下：“我不敢有任何欺骗太子的心思。”

刘盈笑吟吟的看着大祭司道：“既然没有的话，那你就重新回到座位上，和我说说你是打算怎么安顿那数万个育龄妇人的。”

大祭司抬起手来，擦了擦额头上的汗水以后，这才重新回到了矮几后边的软塌上，跪坐了下来。

“这数万育龄妇人，当初我的想法是觉得，把这些人弄到了我们谷蠡部落来以后，谷蠡部落在未来就可以多出许多的人口，只是……”

他无可奈何的看着刘盈：“我实在是没有想到，这足足四万多的女人，到了我们这里以后，每天消耗的粮食，都是一个天文数字，所以我就动了心思，看能不能把这些育龄妇人的难题，抛给殿下。”

刘盈左右两侧的侍卫们听着大祭司的话，一个个都露出凶恶的目光来。

刘盈却抚掌道：“很好，我喜欢说真话的人，只是你怎么就觉得，寡人一定会接受这四万多育龄妇人？”

“这可不是四百四千，这是整整四万人，寡人北上的大军也不过是六万人而已，如果加上这四万人的话，那就是整整十万之数目！”

大祭司尴尬的看着刘盈笑了笑：“一开始的时候，臣是没有打算对殿下说实话的，可是殿下既然已经知道了臣下想要做什么，臣下就觉得，扭扭捏捏的话，那只会让殿下更加猜忌，所以索性直接说出来，殿下如果觉得可行的话。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"No...it won't happen." The high priest struggled to say these words.

Liu Ying waved her hand and said: "You may really think that that day will not happen, or you may think that the prince who comes is just a baby general. What does he know? Time is the most powerful enemy. As time goes by, hard stones will crack, turn into sand, and be stepped on under people's feet."

"The powerful Han Empire may be like this."

Liu Ying didn't give the high priest a chance to quibble at all. He said quickly: "At least, wasn't that how the powerful Qin State perished like this?"

"You may want to say that the current situation of Qin State and my Han Dynasty are different, but in fact, if the problem of the Xiongnu is not solved, it will last for many years."

"So, if you are still taking chances, purify yourself as soon as possible. Otherwise, by the time I come to purify your thoughts, the problem may be much more serious than you think."

The high priest left his seat and knelt down towards Liu Ying: "I dare not have any intention of deceiving the prince."

Liu Ying looked at the high priest with a smile and said: "If not, then you can return to your seat and tell me how you plan to accommodate those tens of thousands of women of childbearing age."

The high priest raised his hand and wiped the sweat from his forehead, then returned to the couch behind the short table and knelt down.

"With these tens of thousands of women of childbearing age, my original idea was that after bringing these people to our Guli tribe, the Guli tribe would be able to have a much larger population in the future, but..."

He looked at Liu Ying helplessly: "I really didn't expect that these more than 40,000 women would consume an astronomical amount of food every day after arriving here, so I thought about it and saw if I could throw the problems of these women of childbearing age to His Highness."

The guards on Liu Ying's left and right sides listened to the high priest's words, and each of them looked fiercely.

But Liu Ying stroked her hands and said: "Very good, I like people who tell the truth, but why do you think that I will definitely accept these more than 40,000 women of childbearing age?"

"This is not four hundred and four thousand, this is a full 40,000 people. Our army going north is only 60,000 people. If we add these 40,000 people, it will be a full 100,000 people!"

The high priest looked at Liu Ying awkwardly and smiled: "At the beginning, I had no intention of telling the truth to His Highness, but since Your Highness already knew what I wanted to do, I felt that if I was coy, it would only make His Highness more suspicious, so I simply said it directly, if His Highness thought it was feasible.
